title: Jujutsu Kaisen Creator Returns With New Look at Yuta Ahead of Season 4
content: Jujutsu Kaisen is now hard at work for its return with Season 4 of the anime, and the creator behind it all has returned with a cool new look at Yuta Okkotsu and Rika to help celebrate. Jujutsu Kaisen originally came to an end with Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine back in 2024 .
author: ComicBook

title: Gintama Goes Full Demon Slayer With New Netflix Movie Release – Watch
content: Gintama has returned to Netflix with a new feature film release you can stream now, and it’s going full Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba thanks to the popularity of the Infinity Castle trilogy.
author: ComicBook

title: Manga 'Kono Oto Tomare!' Ends in Three Chapters
content: The official X account for manga creator Amyuu Sakura announced on Sunday that their Kono Oto Tomare! ( Stop This Sound! ) manga will end in three chapters. The countdown includes the upcoming chapter in the October 2026 issue of Jump SQ. magazine, which is scheduled to release on September 4.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend Reveals New Visual, Second Main Trailer and Theme Song
content: Rascal Does Not Dream of a Dear Friend anime film revealed its second main trailer ahead of its October 16, 2026 theatrical premiere in Japan. The film will bring the Rascal Does Not Dream anime series to its conclusion.
author: Anime Corner

title: Sagrada Reset Author Yutaka Kōno's Sayonara no Iikata Nante Shiranai Novel Series Gets Manga Adaptation
content: Sagrada Reset novel author Yutaka Kōno announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Friday their Sayonara no Iikata Nante Shiranai (I Don't Know How to Say Goodbye) novel series will get a manga adaptation by Yukiko Seike ( 5 Centimeters per Second ) on Kodansha 's Comic Days platform in fall.
author: ANN

title: 'Medalist Movie' Reveals New Staff, Trailer, February 19 Premiere
content: The Medalist Special Exhibition 2026 event revealed the new staff, a second teaser visual (pictured), and special trailer for the anime sequel film adaptation of Tsurumaikada 's Medalist manga on Sunday. The anime movie is scheduled to premiere in Japanese theaters on February 19, 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Medalist Movie Reveals New Teaser Trailer, Visual, February 19, 2027 Premiere
content: Medalist sequel anime movie revealed a new trailer and visual, along with a February 19, 2027 premiere date. The movie was announced earlier this year, while the news came immediately after the TV anime’s second season concluded on March 22.
author: Anime Corner

title: Sankaku Head's My Darling Devilish Daughter Manga Ends in 6th Volume
content: The fifth volume of Sankaku Head 's My Darling Devilish Daughter ( Boku no Manamusume ) manga announced on Friday the series will end in the sixth volume, which ships in 2027. Seven Seas publishes the series in English and describes the story: Sami's just a sweet little girl…who happens to have demonic powers.
author: ANN

title: Kо̄ki Inо̄ Replaces Ayumu Murase as Kanon Himeno in The Idolm@ster Side M Franchise
content: Bandai Namco Entertainment 's Idolm@ster franchise announced on Friday voice actor Kо̄ki Inо̄ will take over the role of Kanon Himeno from Ayumu Murase in The Idolm@ster SideM franchise, after the company announced on August 18 Murase would "graduate" from the role.
author: ANN

title: Every Crunchyroll Anime Film of the Year Champion Since the Awards Began
content: Crunchyroll Anime Awards is one of the biggest events of the anime year, celebrating the biggest anime releases of the decade. The award ceremony has evolved since its inception, with more categories being added since 2017.
author: ComicBook
